name: Doug Stewart
office: City of Malibu, Member of the City Council

items.text: Doug Stewart is a Malibu City Council member, elected in 2022. He served as vice chair of the Public Safety Commission and has been a CERT member since 2008. He is chairman and CEO of Sierra Nevada Investment Management and a longtime banker.

sentences.text: Doug Stewart is a Malibu City Council member, elected in 2022.
He served as vice chair of the Public Safety Commission and has been a CERT member since 2008.
He is chairman and CEO of Sierra Nevada Investment Management and a longtime banker.

items.text: He says he brought the California Highway Patrol back to the Pacific Coast Highway in 2024 after 33 years. He supported a $50 million Pacific Coast Highway safety project and emphasized pedestrian protection. His campaign says he advanced a 2026 lawsuit for local control of hiking trails. He says homelessness dropped from 250 to 50 during his term.
